M-BUTTON-WIDGET.Purpose: Native RimWorld text button with a single action Prop and optional stock native background.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Button Label, Font, TextAlign, Color, DrawButtonBackground, Disabled, Tooltip and OnClick.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Stock native background toggle through DrawButtonBackground; custom decoration is composed through View.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Global event routing and pointer capture — owned by M-FLEX-EVENTS and game IMGUI.

Requirements.REQ-001: Button.OnClick is the single action Prop; its OnMouseUp hook remains independent of native Widgets.ButtonText and the FlexEventDispatcher routing machinery.
Requirements.REQ-002: Disabled suppresses the OnClick action and disables native ButtonText activation.
Requirements.REQ-003: Widgets.ButtonText retains native control presentation. DrawButtonBackground false permits an enclosing View to supply the decorative surface.
Requirements.REQ-004: Intrinsic Button measure uses label font metrics and internal padding, respecting imposed width/height modes.

Inputs.IN-001: Button label, OnClick action, Disabled and appearance Props.

Outputs.OUT-001: Native drawn button content and optional click action notification.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Native IMGUI drawing and action invocation via OnMouseUp when enabled.
